title: Director, Enterprise Process Owner
description:
At Deckers Brands, Together, Every Step is a promise kept that every employee can bring their authentic self, is valued and supported, as a whole person, at work and beyond. Together, Every Step is how we continue to deliver exceptional business results, experience an amazing place to work, and have a positive impact on the communities and world around us.

Job Title: Director, Enterprise Process Owner
Reports to: VP, Enterprise Process Organization

Location: Remote - US

Interested applicants must reside in one of the following approved states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Indiana, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New York, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Texas, Utah, Washington

The Role

Are you ready to lead and innovate in a dynamic environment? As the Director, Enterprise Process Owner, you will be responsible for owning, overseeing, and improving select end-to-end business processes across the Deckers organization. This role ensures that enterprise processes are strategic, efficient, effective, and consistent across global functions, regions, and systems. You will partner cross-functionally to drive continuous improvement, standardization, and adoption of global processes, while embedding best practices and ensuring compliance. Join us in shaping the future of our enterprise processes and making a significant impact on our organization.

We celebrate diversity--of your background, your experiences and your unique identity. We are committed to ensuring an inclusive and equitable workplace where all of our employees can Come as They Are. We believe that when we bring our different perspectives to work, we are truly Better Together.

Your Impact

  • Process Ownership:
    • Own and create the design, implementation, and ongoing improvement of assigned global enterprise processes.
    • Establish consistent and standardized procedures and workflows across the organization.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration:
    • Partner with functional leaders, brands, regions, and Digital & Data to align process priorities, requirements, and improvement opportunities.
    • Develop and execute change management strategies to ensure smooth adoption of new systems and processes across the organization.
  • Training & Documentation:
    • Develop and maintain SOPs, process flow maps, and supporting documentation for assigned processes.
    • Support training and capability building to ensure stakeholders understand roles, responsibilities, and accountabilities.
  • Performance Measurement & Systems Enablement:
    • Define and monitor KPIs to track process performance and drive continuous improvement.
    • Work with Digital & Data teams to implement and integrate new systems or technologies that support the process.
  • Alignment & Compliance:
    • Ensure that the processes are aligned to and in support of enterprise strategies.
    • Ensure that the processes adhere to relevant regulations and policies.

Who You Are

  • Education/Certifications:
    • Bachelor’s degree in management, business, industrial engineering, or similar. Master's degree is preferred.
  • Work Experience:
    • Minimum of 10+ years of experience in consulting, brand management, continuous improvement, or a related field.
    • Hands-on experience in merchandising, planning, product creation/management, go-to-market process, and/or supply chain.
    • Knowledge of continuous improvement methodologies and data analysis.
    • Strong background in change management and driving organizational adoption of new systems.
    • Experience working in footwear is a plus.
  • Skills/Competencies:
    • Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills.
    • Deep understanding of business process methodologies, including process design, improvement, and optimization.
    • Strong analytical skills to analyze data, identify trends, and develop solutions to process issues.
    • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with stakeholders, build consensus, and drive change.
    • Ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams, manage change, and drive process improvements.
    • Experience in managing complex projects, including planning, execution, and monitoring.
    • Natural multitasker, able to move quickly from long-term thinking to short-term execution.
    • Thrive in ambiguity and are not afraid of a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
    • Extremely strong towards taking action and problem-solving.
    • Must be able to build trusting relationships and collaborate across the Deckers enterprise.
    • Must be willing to speak truth to power and openly, empathetically challenge standard thinking with new ideas, fresh approaches, and solutions.
    • Intellectual curiosity - you enjoy getting to the bottom of things and leave no stone unturned in solving a problem.
    • Strong EQ and willingness to listen and learn.
    • Impeccable time management and the ability to juggle multiple high-priority projects at the same time.
    • Strong working knowledge of process/continuous improvement strategies and frameworks, project management, and KPI measurement.
    • Self-directed and can work independently/autonomously with little oversight and still deliver stellar results.

What We'll Give You

  • Competitive Pay and Bonuses - We’ve created a variety of competitive compensation programs to foster career development, reward success and to show our employees just how much they’re valued.
  • Financial Planning and wellbeing - No matter what financial goals our employees have set, we want to help them get there. Our plans provide powerful ways to protect income, pay for expenses and invest in the future.
  • Time away from work - Sometimes we need time away to be with family, focus on our health or just simply recharge. Our plans support our employees’ needs to get out, get healthy and come back stronger than ever.
  • Extras, discounts and perks - Being a valued member of the Deckers Brands team means more than just a paycheck. From generous discounts to community-based programs, we offer a variety of cool extras
  • Growth and Development - Deckers Brands was built on the idea of pursuing passion. That’s why we offer extensive opportunities and support for personal and professional development.
  • Health and Wellness - There’s nothing basic about our comprehensive health and wellness programs and offerings. While at work and at play, we aim to support a healthy lifestyle.

The salary range is $195,000 - $205,000. Individual pay will be determined by location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Equal Employment Opportunity
Diversity and inclusion are key to our success. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences and backgrounds who share a passion for our brands. We welcome qualified applicants regardless of their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, age, military or veteran status, mental or physical disability, medical condition and all the other beautiful parts of your identity.

title: Escalation Manager
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission :

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and / or sales opportunities with key customers.

The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.

In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.

Your Impact

  • Escalation Leadership
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
  • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
  • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
  • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues
  • Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it
  • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
  • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
  • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications
  • Risk Management
  • Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place
  • A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
  • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process / system / product
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
  • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
  • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
  • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Customer Experience
  • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and / or service delivery roles
  • Past experience as Escalations Engineer / Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired
  • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators
  • Program / Project management
  • Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer
  • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA / SLO / Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like
  • Collaboration and Influence
  • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
  • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
  • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
  • Experience with Networking / Security Products
  • Knowledge of LAN / WAN technologies, encompassing general routing / switching / security for both branch and data center architectures
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales teams, and other invested parties
  • Creative thinking, adaptability, and versatility
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Strong ability to influence and effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future issues

    • Additional Information

    The Team

    The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.

    Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making

title: Escalation Manager
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission :

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and / or sales opportunities with key customers.

The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.

In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.

Your Impact

  • Escalation Leadership
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
  • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
  • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
  • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues
  • Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it
  • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
  • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
  • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications
  • Risk Management
  • Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place
  • A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
  • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process / system / product
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
  • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
  • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
  • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Customer Experience
  • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and / or service delivery roles
  • Past experience as Escalations Engineer / Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired
  • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators
  • Program / Project management
  • Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer
  • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA / SLO / Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like
  • Collaboration and Influence
  • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
  • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
  • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
  • Experience with Networking / Security Products
  • Knowledge of LAN / WAN technologies, encompassing general routing / switching / security for both branch and data center architectures
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales teams, and other invested parties
  • Creative thinking, adaptability, and versatility
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Strong ability to influence and effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future issues

    • Additional Information

    The Team

    The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.

    Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making

    As Escalation Managers, each team member will be at the vanguard of our dedication to cybersecurity. Addressing the most pressing situations for our customers, you will hold a central position in solidifying our reputation as the go-to cybersecurity partner. This role demands proactivity, efficiency, an unwavering dedication to constant refinement, and a passion for customer satisfaction.

    Driving continuous learnings and efficiency into the Escalation Management and Product Lifecycle is one of the key areas for the team as we continue our focus on customer experience.

    Our Commitment

    We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple : we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

  • Light marketing ops: Assist with ad uploads, naming conventions, UTM hygiene, and creative calendars.
  • Industry learning: Rapidly absorb what makes roofing ads work: seasonality, storm events, insurance language, compliance “do’s and don’ts.”

Must-have skills & experience

  • 2–5+ years in graphic design and / or content editing (agency, in-house, or freelance). Roofing / home services / renovation background strongly preferred.
  • Editor-first: Premiere Pro, CapCut Pro, or Final Cut + After Effects basics. Figma / Adobe Illustrator / Photoshop proficiency.
  • Proven portfolio of direct-response creative (ads that sell, not just look pretty).
  • Strong sense of hooks, pacing, and clarity; understands attention economics for 3–30s ads.
  • Comfortable working from raw, imperfect footage (phone clips, job-site audio) and making it look sharp.
  • Solid copy instincts: headlines, overlays, lower-thirds, CTA placement.
  • Organized: version control, file naming, and asset libraries.

Nice-to-haves

  • Roofing / home services portfolio (before / after, crew, drone, hail / storm angles).

What success looks like (90-day scorecard)

  • Ship 30–50 creative variations / month across clients (mix of video + static).

  • Build / maintain client brand kits and a searchable asset library.
  • Document a Creative Playbook for roofing offers, angles, and compliance.

KPIs you’ll own

  • Thumb-stop / 3-sec view rate (shorts / reels).
  • CTR on first-touch ads; CPL contribution for lead gen funnels.
  • Creative velocity: variants shipped per week and on-time rate.
  • Iteration speed: time from data insight → new variant live.

Tools we use

Adobe CC (Premiere / AE / PS / AI) or CapCut Pro, Figma, Google Drive, Slack, Notion, Meta Ads Library, Frame.io (or equivalent).

Work setup

Fully remote. Standard working hours 9:00–5:00 PM Central (CDT). Occasional optional travel for content capture or team onsites.

Compensation

  • $500–$1,000 per month (DOE) + performance bonus tied to creative wins.
  • Benefits (if full-time): PTO, holidays, gear stipend, education budget.

How to apply

  • Portfolio link + 2–3 ad examples with a one-liner on why they worked
  • Your tool stack + availability
  • Confirmation you can work 9:00–5:00 PM CDT (align your timezone)

Paid test (required)

We’ll give you a raw roofing job-site folder (clips + stills). In 48 hours, deliver:

  • 2 x 15s vertical ads (3 hook variants each)

Role expectations (how we work)

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Overview

AI Engineer – Data & Automation (Healthcare SaaS)

About Us

AMX Healthcare is building a new SaaS platform to transform how healthcare staffing is managed—connecting clients, contractors, and job opportunities with speed and compliance. We’re investing in AI to streamline recruiting, automate data flows, and surface insights from our knowledge base (resumes, job descriptions, Confluence, ATS / CRM, etc.).

Role Overview

We’re hiring an AI Engineer – Data & Automation to design and build intelligent systems that bring structure, insight, and automation to our staffing workflows. You’ll turn unstructured data (resumes, job descriptions, documents, chats) into actionable intelligence using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) , document intelligence , and structured extraction . This is a founding role to develop and own the AI function —defining architecture, best practices, and solutions that become foundational for our platform and business.

The Impact

  • Time-to-fill ↓ 30–50% : OCR → parse → validate → post touches from hours to minutes.
  • Zero-drama compliance : Primary-source checks, expirations, and audit logs built in.
  • Revenue & margin ↑ : Accurate pay-package math and cleaner timesheets reduce adjustments / write-offs.
  • Cash flow ↑ : Invoice creation from approved time, automated AR, and payroll sync reduce DSO and billing errors.
  • Recruiter capacity ↑ : AI SMS cadences and clean data flows speed shortlists and follow-through.
  • Decision speed : Live Sheets / Excel / Power BI replaces weekly spreadsheet marathons.
  • Platform rigor : MLOps, observability, and cost governance keep AI stable, safe, and affordable.

What You’ll Build

  • Document AI pipelines : OCR → classify → extract → validate → post for licenses, immunizations, I-9s, background checks, timesheets, and offers. Enforce strict JSON schemas, confidence scores, and text-span provenance.
  • Compliance automation : Primary-source license checks, date / format rules, name / DOB matching, immunization logic, and timesheet math (REG / OT).
  • Workflow integrations : Event-driven APIs / webhooks across Applicant Tracking Systems , healthcare compliance platforms , job boards , CRM / Marketing systems (e.g., HubSpot or Salesforce ), and Task Management Tools (e.g., Jira, Zoom Tasks).
  • Text message (SMS) automation : AI-assisted campaigns and cadences (opt-in, nurture, reactivation) triggered from ATS / CRM events; personalize copy, schedule sends, ingest replies / MMS docs, and auto-log to the system of record.
  • Comms → system of record : Integrate VoIP / SMS (e.g., RingCentral, TextUs, BeeTexting) with ATS / Compliance to auto-log activity, attach files, and trigger workflows.
  • Customer support & knowledge base automation : Zendesk + knowledge base workflows—AI triage / routing, macro suggestions, agent-assist via RAG with citations, chatbot deflection, and SLA dashboards.
  • Marketing & CMS automation : Content workflows with Jasper AI ; landing / job content in HubSpot CMS , Webflow , or WordPress .
  • Pay package automation : Bill rates + stipends + guaranteed hours → weekly packages with audit trails.
  • Finance, accounting & payroll automation (required) : Integrations with QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools to :
  • Generate invoices from approved time, bill rates, and contract terms; handle credits / adjustments.
  • Sync AR / AP, post journal entries, reconcile payments; surface exceptions for review.
  • Automate payroll prep from timesheets and pay packages; route exceptions to HITL queues with full auditability.
  • Knowledge assistants : RAG chatbots over Confluence / SharePoint / Drive / ATS / CRM with permissions, citations, and human-in-the-loop review.
  • Live reporting : Streams to Google Sheets , Excel , and Power BI for exceptions, credential heatmaps, ready-to-work rosters, AR aging, and payroll variance.

MLOps & Platform

  • Dataset / prompt / embedding versioning; golden test sets; offline / online evals; A / B tests.
  • CI / CD for data and models; rollbacks; feature flags; latency / reliability SLOs; canary / blue-green.
  • Durable orchestration and state (idempotency, retries / backoff, dead-letter handling).
  • Observability (traces / metrics / cost), drift detection, PII / HIPAA redaction, RBAC, audit logs.
  • Cost governance : token / throughput controls, caching / TTL, embedding reuse, batching, FinOps reporting.

Must-Have

  • Strong software engineering in Python and / or C# .
  • Hands-on LLM / RAG (embeddings, retrieval, prompt design, evaluation).
  • Document ingestion at scale (PDF / HTML / images), schema’d extraction, validation.
  • Secure, auditable data design ( HIPAA / PII ), APIs / webhooks, event-driven workflows.
  • Experience integrating enterprise systems (ATS / Compliance / Job Boards / HubSpot / Salesforce ).
  • Experience integrating QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools for automated invoicing / payroll with audit trails.
  • MLOps fundamentals : data / model versioning, CI / CD, monitoring, rollback.

Nice-to-Have

  • Healthcare staffing / credentialing domain.
  • Resume parsing APIs (Sovren, Textkernel, Affinda) or document intelligence services.
  • iPaaS / workflow tools (Zapier / Make), queues, human-in-the-loop review UIs.
  • Deploying AI apps on managed cloud (AKS / App Service or equivalents).
  • Information retrieval, knowledge graphs, or NLP research background.
  • Prior work on compliance-heavy systems (healthcare, finance, government).
  • Zendesk automation; Jasper AI content ops; CMS automation (HubSpot CMS, Webflow, WordPress).
  • Contributions to open-source AI / LLM frameworks or a strong portfolio of shipped AI projects.

Why AMX

  • Founding scope & ownership : Build the AI function—architecture, standards, roadmap.
  • Executive air cover : Direct line to the Head of Engineering; CEO-level sponsorship to ship.
  • Modern, open stack : Integrations across ATS, compliance, job boards, CRM / Marketing (HubSpot / Salesforce) , VoIP / SMS, CMS, accounting / payroll , and reporting—pick the best tool for the job.
  • Mission-critical outcomes : Help clinicians reach the bedside faster with fewer errors—visible impact on placements, revenue, compliance, cash conversion, and payroll accuracy.
  • Remote-first, pragmatic culture : Production over prototypes, HIPAA / PII first, human-in-the-loop where it matters.

description:
Role: Executive Operations Integrator (Beauty Industry - MUST HAVE EXPERIENCE)

Role Specifics: We are only considering candidates with experience in the beauty industry. Please only apply if you have worked in the beauty industry/salon space.

Contract: Full-time Remote Contractor (40 hours weekly / 160 hours monthly)

Business Hours: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM EST

Rate: $2,000 - $3,000 USD monthly / $24,000 - $36,000 annually (salary is negotiable based on experience and location)

Availability to Start: Immediately

Client's Profile

Founded in New Jersey in 1997, this award-winning luxury salon and wellness spa is more than a destination for beauty; it's a space for transformation, self-expression, and connection. With multiple locations and a commitment to continuous growth, they've cultivated a brand rooted in intentional service, elevated aesthetics, and deep care for their clients and team.

What You'll Do

As the Executive Operations Integrator, this role is not a traditional operations assistant role, and it's not suited for a traditional candidate. The client is building more than a business. They are nurturing a vision of trust, growth, and collaborative improvement. As the Executive Operations Integrator, you are the trusted partner who supports the founder from behind the scenes, with clear systems, executive presence, and emotional intelligence.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Operations & Integrator Coordination: 60% Role Allocation

Team & Operations Management

  • Be the primary support to the Founder in managing day-to-day operations and overall team integration.
  • Be the point of contact for internal issues and help with swift resolution.
  • Help create and implement organizational strategies that support company goals.
  • Lead planning sessions, team meetings, and 1:1s; take notes and follow up on action items.
  • Manage projects from start to finish, including timelines, budgets, and delivery.
  • Track team KPIs and tasks, offering support where needed.
  • Prepare reports on Operations and Team Performance for the Founder.
  • Identify ways to improve processes and communication, applying emotional intelligence in communication dynamics.
  • Create and maintain an easy-to-follow Operations Playbook.

System Management & Process Oversight

  • Manage internal tools like Zenoti and Qnity, including employee logs, credentials, client scheduling, cancellations, promo campaigns, etc.
  • Oversee inventory and updates in Zenoti and Shopify, ensuring stock is correct and within budget.
  • Review reports and workflows to find and fix inefficiencies.

Marketing & Content Coordination: 25% Role Allocation

Marketing Coordination

  • Coordinate marketing tasks across departments to keep campaigns on track.
  • Oversee the submission and organization of marketing materials, advertisements, and promotions within Zenoti and Shopify.

Content Curation & Social Media Management

  • Support social media efforts by duplicating and scheduling content (IG, FB, LinkedIn, Google) to align with business initiatives.
  • Write simple copy, quotes, or weekly updates as needed, ensuring consistent brand tone.
  • Monitor engagement and share relevant content ideas as needed.

Strategic Founder & Client Support: 10% Role Allocation

  • Own the Founder's calendar, meetings, and priorities; give daily updates.
  • Keep the Founder's email inbox organized, respond to messages, and track follow-ups.
  • Turn the Founder's ideas (notes or voice memos) into actionable tasks.
  • Protect the Founder's time while supporting the team and aligning priorities.
  • Communicate with clients as needed, handling urgent escalations, urgent follow-ups, and building relationships.

What You Should Have

Must-haves:

  • At least seven years of experience in Executive Support, Operations, or Integrator roles, ideally supporting C-level or Founder Executives.
  • Experience supporting a Founder or Executive in a Beauty, Wellness, or Lifestyle brand, particularly in fast-paced, multi-business environments.
  • At least one year of experience in a global remote or virtual environment for a company or with clients in North America, Europe, Australia, or the UAE.
  • Strong integrator and operational management skills, with the ability to translate high-level strategies into actionable plans and workflows.
  • Mastery of English communication skills, both written and verbal, with a professional tone and neutral accent for both internal coordination and client correspondence.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, coordinate with cross-functional teams, and manage day-to-day operations.
  • Client-facing experience, with the ability to handle escalations professionally and maintain relationships.
  • Hands-on experience with Zenoti (or similar scheduling/inventory systems) and Shopify for backend coordination and updates.
  • Experience in light copywriting, editing, and scheduling social media content across IG, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Google platforms.
  • Proficient in remote office tools like Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Calendar) and Slack (or Teams).
  • Experience with project management tools like Asana, Notion, or ClickUp.
  • Proven experience supporting internal operations, maintaining trackers and summary reports (e.g., logins, performance, promos).
  • Exposure to process optimization frameworks, with the ability to implement improvements and create SOPs from scratch.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative without close supervision, and keep executives focused on what matters most.

Technology Specifications:

  • Minimum 100 Mbps Internet Speed
  • Windows 11 or MacOS 15 Sequoia
  • Minimum Intel i5 8th gen with 8GB RAM or Apple M1 chip with 8GB RAM
  • Webcam and Headset
  • Designated Quiet Office Space

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS) framework, including L10 meetings, Rocks, Scorecards, and IDS.
  • Basic design knowledge for editing branded visual assets in Canva.

Who You Are

We are hoping you are someone who:

  • Naturally steps in to solve problems, keep things moving, and stays a few steps ahead.
  • Thinks clearly and critically, great at untangling complex challenges, spotting what's not working, and helping build smoother systems.
  • Communicates with clarity and confidence, whether giving a quick update to the team or coordinating with external partners, you know how to get the message across with emotional intelligence.
  • Keeps everything (and everyone) on track, juggles timelines, priorities, and moving pieces with calm precision and care for the brand image.

Descomplicamos a vida de milhares de empreendedores. Somos um sistema ERP para micro e pequenas empresas, com ferramentas que possibilitam uma gestão operacional e financeira mais integrada, simples e prática.

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora Fullstack Sênior , você fará parte de um time com mais de 80 profissionais e irá atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções escaláveis e resilientes utilizando prioritariamente PHP e evoluindo conhecimentos e aplicações em Golang .

Nosso time de tecnologia é responsável por concretizar as necessidades e desejos dos nossos clientes e parceiros de mercado!

Essa oportunidade é para atuação remota, no regime CLT, com uma jornada de 40 horas semanais.

Vem com a gente ajudar empresas a administrarem seus negócios de forma simples e inteligente, através de tecnologia!

Main responsibilities

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Desenho e construção de soluções evolutivas e resilientes;
  • Acompanhar e controlar débitos técnicos das soluções;
  • Participar ativamente na estratégia com o time de produto/negócio;
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica para o código desenvolvido.
  • Controlar os níveis de obsolescência da plataforma;
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com outros membros da equipe.
  • Atuar como mentor para engenheiros de software juniores e intermediários, ajudando-os a crescer tecnicamente e profissionalmente.
  • Buscar evolução contínua da tecnologia e solução utilizada, monitorando o desempenho de aplicativos e sistemas para garantir agilidade e eficiência;
  • Fomentar cultura de revisão de código, DevOps e desenvolvimento seguro;
  • Participar de todas as fases do design de sistemas de alta criticidade, analisando os requisitos, propondo novas soluções que agreguem valor para as áreas técnica e de negócios e visando obter melhorias para o produto;
  • Garantir a qualidade do código e a observabilidade das métricas de negócio e sistêmicas;
  • Estabelecer rotinas de teste unitários e automatizados dos produtos desenvolvidos;
  • Prover suporte técnico L3.

Requirements and skills

E para tirar de letra, você precisará:

  • Experiência de desenvolvimento de software web com linguagens como Golang e frameworks relacionados;
  • Experiência de desenvolvimento de software web com linguagens como PHP e frameworks relacionados;
  • Domínio em versionamento de código via Gitlab/Github;
  • Experiência com boas práticas: SOLID, Clean Code, Design Patterns
  • Experiência em banco de dados relacionais e não relacionais (MySQL, DynamoDB, DocumentDB);
  • Experiência em banco de dados chave-valor, como o Redis
  • Conhecimento de HTML, Javascript, CSS e frameworks de front-end;
  • Experiência em arquitetura event-driven, mensageria e orientação a eventos (Kafka, AMQ, SQS, SNS.. etc);
  • Conhecimento de testes automatizados e testes unitários e conceitos de desenvolvimento seguro;
  • Inglês técnico;
  • Experiência com monitoramento e observabilidade (APM, logs, métricas, tracing);
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Kanban, Scrum, etc);
  • Conhecimento em DDD (Domain Driven Development)
  • Experiência em arquitetura de microsserviços;

E se tiver isso também, melhor ainda:

  • Experiência com sistemas de grande complexidade e escala;
  • Familiaridade com esteiras de CI/CD, Docker e Terraform;
  • Experiência em soluções Cloud (AWS);
  • Apoio na tomada de decisão técnica (escalabilidade, performance, trade-offs);
  • Nível básico em Espanhol.

Additional information

O que nós oferecemos:

  • Convênio médico;
  • Convênio odontológico;
  • Vale-refeição ou vale-alimentação;
  • Auxílio-creche;
  • Auxílio home office
  • Programa de participação de lucros-PPR;
  • Day Off no mês de aniversário;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Wellhub;
  • Férias&Co (benefício de viagens);
  • Zenklub (psicoterapia/atendimento nutricional);
  • Licença maternidade de 6 meses e paternidade de 20 dias;
  • Horário flexível;
  • Auxílio Educação e auxílio idiomas;

Importante ressaltar:

Essa e todas as vagas abertas da companhia LWSA são elegíveis para todas as pessoas, independente de gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, acessibilidade e/ou condição social.

Ressaltamos que nossas vagas estão abertas para todas as pessoas com deficiência (PcDs).

title: Executivo De Vendas
description:
Sobre a Verzo

A Verzo foi fundada em 2015 com o objetivo de auxiliar os hospitais e prestadores de serviço de saúde a aprimorarem seus resultados financeiros. Iniciamos movidos pelo propósito de ajudar a saúde do Brasil e animados com os desafios que o setor propicia.

Começamos como Aliança Hospitalar, prestando serviços de consultoria para hospitais. Logo nos apaixonamos por tecnologia e criamos o sistema VERZO. Com um time qualificado, o VERZO cresceu de forma exponencial e hoje atuamos com hospitais de todos os portes e perfis em todos os cantos do Brasil. Nos tornamos nativos de tecnologia e adotamos o nome VERZO para nossa companhia.

Durante a pandemia, percebemos o impacto causado não só nas instituições mas também nas pessoas. Decidimos lançar novas soluções de simples adesão, rápida implantação e que facilitassem a vida dos profissionais da área da saúde.

Hoje atendemos os hospitais e redes mais exigentes em termos de tecnologia e resultados. Estamos sempre inovando e criando novas soluções em parcerias com nossos clientes.

Viemos para ficar, valorizamos relações duradouras e a satisfação de nossos clientes é nosso principal objetivo.

O que fazemos

Por meio de ciência de dados proprietária, nossas ferramentas trazem um ROI (retorno do investimento) claro e atrativo, além de apoiarmos as equipes na gestão financeira, cadastro, ciclo de receita, suprimentos e fiscal no atingimento de seus objetivos. Já foram identificados mais de R$ 2 bilhões em oportunidades de aumento de lucro para +350 clientes no país.

Formamos parcerias com essas equipes que, com o uso de nossas ferramentas, entregam mais resultados para seus gestores como redução de glosas / bloqueios, aumento da rentabilidade de medicamentos e materiais médicos, tanto via redução de custos quanto aumento de receita e revisão de mix, e automatização de processos de controle da cadeia de fornecedores e fiscais. Além disso, otimizamos processos internos via tecnologia para liberar tempo da equipe para dedicar atenção e esforços ao que realmente gera valor.

Tudo que desenvolvemos foi com base no feedback das dores destas equipes em diversos hospitais Brasil afora. Conhecemos profundamente as necessidades do setor e sabemos como ajudar.

Prêmios e reconhecimentos

A Verzo é celebrada por sua excelência em inovação e qualidade de serviço. Fomos honrados com diversos reconhecimentos ao longo de nossa história como os destaques de “Tendência para a Saúde em 2024” pela Revista Medicina S / A em 2024, “Top Latin America HealthTech” pela HeathCare Tech Outlook em 2022, e selecionados pela Endeavor como uma das empresas de alto impacto no Brasil por meio do programa Scale Up Endeavor no mesmo ano.

Descrição da vaga e responsabilidades

Estamos em busca de um Executivo de Vendas para integrar nossa equipe. As principais responsabilidades da posição incluem:

  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes.
  • Gerenciar funil de vendas de ponta a ponta: prospecção, qualificação, apresentações, propostas e fechamento.
  • Conduzir reuniões de demonstração do produto.
  • Negociar aspectos comerciais e garantir a melhor experiência do cliente durante o processo comercial.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de Marketing e Customer Success para alinhar estratégias e melhorar a jornada do cliente.
  • Alimentar e organizar o CRM, garantindo previsibilidade de pipeline.
  • Atingir e superar metas de vendas.

Local de trabalho

O trabalho será remoto, permitindo desempenho das funções de onde desejar. Por vezes, haverá necessidade de viagens para eventos e encontros presenciais com clientes.

Regime de contratação:

Contrato PJ.

Requisitos mínimos

Ao liderar iniciativas de desenvolvimento de negócios, você desempenha um papel crucial no crescimento da Verzo e na melhoria contínua da saúde no Brasil. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para o sucesso dos hospitais parceiros, proporcionando resultados tangíveis e impactando positivamente a qualidade dos serviços de saúde oferecidos.

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B, preferencialmente em saúde, tecnologia e SaaS.
  • Histórico consistente de atingimento ou superação de metas.
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara, consultiva e orientada a soluções.
  • Possuir conhecimento do setor de saúde e do segmento hospitalar.
  • Capacidade de lidar com diferentes perfis de clientes e influenciadores de decisão (C-level, gestores e técnicos).
  • Conhecimento em gestão de funil de vendas e ferramentas de CRM.
  • Disponibilidade para participação em eventos e encontros presenciais que envolvam viagens.
  • Imersão no entendimento dos produtos da Verzo e nas metodologias de vendas, com foco em SPICED, SPIN e CHALLENGER SALE.

O que valorizamos

  • Experiência prévia no setor de saúde.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo e orientado a resultados.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente dinâmico e de rápido crescimento.
  • Interesse genuíno em gerar impacto positivo no setor de saúde, via inovação, inteligência de dados e tecnologia.
  • Possuir contatos com profissionais do setor e / ou carteira de clientes ativa.

Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você e explorar como podemos construir uma jornada de sucesso juntos.

Se você está em busca de uma oportunidade de crescimento em uma empresa que valoriza a inovação e a excelência na saúde, a Verzo é o lugar ideal para você. Venha fazer parte do nosso time e contribuir com a vida!

title: Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. Canonical has a large and rapidly growing kernel team that underpins Ubuntu and open source more widely across a very wide range of hardware and use cases.

Job Description

We are looking for a Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu to join our team. The successful candidate will collaborate regularly and proactively with a globally distributed team, work closely with external silicon, cloud, or hardware manufacturer delivery teams on bleeding-edge platforms, diagnose and resolve issues in the kernel reported by customers, the community, and discovered by your own rigorous testing, take personal responsibility for the delivery of a flavour of the Ubuntu Linux kernel, improve tooling and automation for delivery and test of Ubuntu Linux kernels, and submit, review, and apply kernel patches, working with both internal and external upstream maintainers.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate regularly and proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Work closely with external silicon, cloud, or hardware manufacturer delivery teams on bleeding-edge platforms
  • Diagnose and resolve issues in the kernel reported by customers, the community, and discovered by your own rigorous testing
  • Take personal responsibility for the delivery of a flavour of the Ubuntu Linux kernel
  • Improve tooling and automation for delivery and test of Ubuntu Linux kernels
  • Submit, review, and apply kernel patches, working with both internal and external upstream maintainers

Requirements

  • Significant programming experience in C, with Python, Golang, or other like languages is also highly regarded
  • Experience with operating system kernel internals and concepts, Linux would be highly regarded but not essential
  • Solid background with git
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Nice-to-have skills

  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other low level system engineering
  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded
  • Understanding of Linux kernel upstream processes and release cycle
  • Performance engineering and security experience
  • Solid background in CI/CD and process automation
  • Prior public involvement with an open source project

What we offer

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Sr Data Analyst - (100% Remoto)
description:
Overview

Aproxime-se. A Invillia não apenas transformou a forma como as empresas mais revolucionárias do mundo criam e desenvolvem estratégias, negócios e produtos digitais. Inovou também a maneira como pessoas apaixonadas por tecnologia, de qualquer lugar do planeta, podem interagir, evoluir, mais conectados do que nunca. Para a Invillia, não importa onde você está. Se é um país grande. Ou uma cidade pequena. E sim a sua vontade. As suas ideias. O seu potencial. O tamanho do seu talento_

Responsabilidades

  • O profissional será responsável em prover soluções técnicas para novas features e dar o suporte necessário às features já existentes.
  • Auxiliar os outros membros do time em questões técnicas, fornecendo a melhor solução para o negócio.
  • Buscar qualidade, incluindo código limpo e legível (clean code).
  • Contribuir com um perfil intra-empreendedor, alinhando objetivos individuais aos objetivos da empresa.

Qualificações epreferências

  • Experiência com serviços da AWS Analytics e ML, como Amazon Kinesis, AWS Glue, Amazon Redshift, Amazon EMR, Amazon Athena, Amazon Sagemaker; apoiar na remoção de restrições que impedem de aproveitar os dados para desenvolver insights de negócios.
  • Experiência com design, desenvolvimento e operações que aproveita profundo conhecimento no uso de serviços como Amazon Kinesis, Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, Amazon Sagemaker, Amazon EMR, tecnologias NoSQL e outras 3rd parties.
  • Desenvolver e definir as principais perguntas de negócios e criar conjuntos de dados que respondam a essas perguntas.
  • Experiência em implementação de plataforma de dados, vivência prática em implementação e ajuste de desempenho de implementações Kinesis/Kafka/Spark/Storm.
  • Experiência com soluções analíticas aplicadas às necessidades de Marketing ou Risco das empresas.
  • Noções básicas de fundamentos de aprendizado de máquina. Capacidade de usar modelos de Machine Learning e implementá-los como parte do pipeline de dados.

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. You should be comfortable taking direction from management and senior course developers to support all levels of technical audiences and working with content that is translated into multiple languages. This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Manager, Technical Course Development.

  • Attend and provide feedback on content for alpha, beta, or instructor-readiness events as needed

  • Learn and follow defined design and development processes
  • Master development tools used in creating instructor-led, self-paced eLearning, and video tutorial content
  • Support other department initiatives as identified by the manager

Remote: Employee is not required to be in or near an office frequently and works from a designated remote work location for the majority of the time.

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position\'s job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

What you bring

Basic

  • BA/BS degree or equivalent work experience
  • 2+ years of experience working with basic technical knowledge and basic instructional design, training development, or training delivery for a technical audience; or experience supporting training within a technical support, technical consulting, engineering, or other technical organization
  • Full professional proficiency in English

Preferred

  • Demonstrated ability to support the design and development tasks for technical course curriculum. Content samples of instructor-led course content, self-paced courses, and/or video-based tutorials that you created are encouraged
  • Demonstrated ability to research, test, and learn software products with guidance for the purpose of training others
  • Basic graphics development and visual design skills
  • Communicate clearly and concisely, both written and verbal
  • Experience in industry-standard course development applications and tools like Articulate 360 and Camtasia
  • Basic project management skills
  • Additional language proficiency in Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, German, French, Dutch, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese
  • Basic understanding of APIs, application best practices, and programming languages such as C# and Java is useful

Life at Docusign

Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
About Us

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.

The Role

As Vendry’s Business Development Manager, you’ll be the frontline force helping brands kick off their search for the right agency partner, helping to craft their marketing strategies in the process. You’ll be responsible for leading our sales efforts with inbound RFP clients—those who have already expressed interest in starting an agency search through Vendry. This is not a traditional outbound-heavy role. Instead, it’s about deeply understanding each client’s needs, pitching our process, running intro calls, managing follow-ups, and ensuring a seamless transition into the matchmaking phase.

You’ll serve as both consultant and salesperson, ensuring that every interested brand sees the value in Vendry’s approach—and ultimately trusts us to guide them through their agency selection journey.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full sales cycle for inbound agency search clients—from initial inquiry through signed engagement with our partners.
  • Conduct consultative sales calls to understand each client’s marketing needs and present Vendry’s search process.
  • Build and deliver compelling pitch materials and follow-ups that reflect Vendry’s value proposition.
  • Collaborate closely with the Agency Operations team to ensure smooth handoff and client experience.
  • Maintain detailed records in our CRM to track pipeline activity and conversion metrics.
  • Help evolve our sales materials and process based on feedback and performance.

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience in a sales or client-facing role, ideally in marketing, advertising, or agency services.
  • Proven ability to run structured sales calls and close consultative deals.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Organized, self-motivated, and comfortable managing multiple prospects at once.
  • Experience working in a remote environment and using CRM tools like HubSpot or Salesforce.
  • Based in Canada and able to work full-time remotely.

Why Join Vendry

Joining Vendry means joining a team at the forefront of transforming how brands find their marketing partners. You’ll work directly with marketers at companies big and small, helping them discover agencies that can take their brand to the next level. We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values creativity, strategic thinking, and initiative.

If you’re a self-starter with a passion for marketing and building relationships, we’d love to hear from you.

Founded in New Jersey in 1997, this award-winning luxury salon and wellness spa is more than a destination for beauty; it's a space for transformation, self-expression, and connection. With multiple locations and a commitment to continuous growth, they've cultivated a brand rooted in intentional service, elevated aesthetics, and deep care for their clients and team. Grounded in a culture of excellence and evolution, the company is led by a visionary founder who blends business with purpose, creating a salon experience that is as soul-filled as it is stylish. Their dedication to excellence has earned them national recognition, including features in major media outlets and accolades from platforms such as CBS and The Knot.

They are nurturing a vision of trust, growth and collaborative improvement. As the Executive Operations Integrator, you are the trusted partner who supports the founder from behind the scenes, with clear systems, executive presence, and emotional intelligence. You don\'t need to be perfect. But you do need to care deeply. This role blends organizational operations, systems management, and strategic support. You\'ll facilitate team meetings, track KPIs, manage tools like Zenoti and Shopify, coordinate marketing tasks, and keep the founder\'s priorities aligned. This hands-on role is ideal for someone who thrives in structure, demonstrates initiative, and prioritizes clarity and detail. Your responsibilities will include :

Operations & Integrator Coordination : 60% Role Allocation

Team & Operations Management

  • Be the primary support to the Founder in managing day-to-day operations and overall team integration.
  • Be the point of contact for internal issues and help with swift resolution.
  • Help create and implement organizational strategies that support company goals.
  • Lead planning sessions, team meetings, and 1 : 1s; take notes and follow up on action items.
  • Manage projects from start to finish, including timelines, budgets, and delivery.
  • Track team KPIs and tasks, offering support where needed.
  • Prepare reports on Operations and Team Performance for the Founder.
  • Identify ways to improve processes and communication, applying emotional intelligence in communication dynamics.
  • Create and maintain an easy-to-follow Operations Playbook.

System Management & Process Oversight

  • Manage internal tools like Zenoti and Qnity, including employee logs, credentials, client scheduling, cancellations, promo campaigns, etc.
  • Oversee inventory and updates in Zenoti and Shopify, ensuring stock is correct and within budget.
  • Review reports and workflows to find and fix inefficiencies.

Marketing & Content Coordination : 25% Role Allocation

Marketing Coordination

  • Coordinate marketing tasks across departments to keep campaigns on track.
  • Oversee the submission and organization of marketing materials, advertisements, and promotions within Zenoti and Shopify.

Content Curation & Social Media Management

  • Support social media efforts by duplicating and scheduling content (IG, FB, LinkedIn, Google) to align with business initiatives.
  • Write simple copy, quotes, or weekly updates as needed, ensuring consistent brand tone.
  • Monitor engagement and share relevant content ideas as needed.

Strategic Founder & Client Support : 10% Role Allocation

  • Own the Founder\'s calendar, meetings, and priorities; give daily updates.
  • Keep the Founder's email inbox organized, respond to messages, and track follow-ups.
  • Turn the Founder\'s ideas (notes or voice memos) into actionable tasks.
  • Protect the Founder\'s time while supporting the team and aligning priorities.
  • Communicate with clients as needed, handling urgent escalations, urgent follow-ups and building relationships.

What You Should Have

Must-haves :

  • At least seven years of experience in Executive Support, Operations, or Integrator roles, ideally supporting C-level or Founder Executives.
  • Experience supporting a Founder or Executive in a Beauty, Wellness, or Lifestyle brand, particularly in fast-paced, multi-business environments.

  • Experience with project management tools like Asana, Notion, or ClickUp.
  • Proven experience supporting internal operations, maintaining trackers and summary reports (e.g., logins, performance, promos).
  • Exposure to process optimization frameworks, with the ability to implement improvements and create SOPs from scratch.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative without close supervision, and keep executives focused on what matters most.

Technology Specifications :

  • Minimum Intel i5 8th gen with 8GB RAM or Apple M1 chip with 8GB RAM

Nice-to-haves :

Who You Are

We are hoping you are someone who :

title: Executivo De Vendas
description:
Sobre a Verzo

A Verzo foi fundada em 2015 com o objetivo de auxiliar os hospitais e prestadores de serviço de saúde a aprimorarem seus resultados financeiros. Iniciamos movidos pelo propósito de ajudar a saúde do Brasil e animados com os desafios que o setor propicia.

Começamos como Aliança Hospitalar, prestando serviços de consultoria para hospitais. Logo nos apaixonamos por tecnologia e criamos o sistema VERZO. Com um time qualificado, o VERZO cresceu de forma exponencial e hoje atuamos com hospitais de todos os portes e perfis em todos os cantos do Brasil. Nos tornamos nativos de tecnologia e adotamos o nome VERZO para nossa companhia.

Durante a pandemia, percebemos o impacto causado não só nas instituições mas também nas pessoas. Decidimos lançar novas soluções de simples adesão, rápida implantação e que facilitassem a vida dos profissionais da área da saúde.

Hoje atendemos os hospitais e redes mais exigentes em termos de tecnologia e resultados. Estamos sempre inovando e criando novas soluções em parcerias com nossos clientes.

Viemos para ficar, valorizamos relações duradouras e a satisfação de nossos clientes é nosso principal objetivo.

O que fazemos

Por meio de ciência de dados proprietária, nossas ferramentas trazem um ROI (retorno do investimento) claro e atrativo, além de apoiarmos as equipes na gestão financeira, cadastro, ciclo de receita, suprimentos e fiscal no atingimento de seus objetivos. Já foram identificados mais de R$ 2 bilhões em oportunidades de aumento de lucro para +350 clientes no país.

Formamos parcerias com essas equipes que, com o uso de nossas ferramentas, entregam mais resultados para seus gestores como redução de glosas / bloqueios, aumento da rentabilidade de medicamentos e materiais médicos, tanto via redução de custos quanto aumento de receita e revisão de mix, e automatização de processos de controle da cadeia de fornecedores e fiscais. Além disso, otimizamos processos internos via tecnologia para liberar tempo da equipe para dedicar atenção e esforços ao que realmente gera valor.

Tudo que desenvolvemos foi com base no feedback das dores destas equipes em diversos hospitais Brasil afora. Conhecemos profundamente as necessidades do setor e sabemos como ajudar.

description:
Quem é Stone Tech?

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Nossa Cultura

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares :

  • Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
  • Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.
  • No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.
  • Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
  • The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

O time de AppSec tem como propósito garantir que os aplicativos sejam desenvolvidos, mantidos e utilizados de maneira segura e protegida contra ameaças cibernéticas. Buscamos evitar que nossos sistemas tenham vulnerabilidades que possam ser exploradas por criminosos cibernéticos, visando proteger dados sensíveis, a privacidade dos usuários e a integridade das aplicações.

Os principais objetivos que perseguimos são :

  • Participar da concepção de novos produtos e serviços, identificando requisitos de segurança
  • Identificação de vulnerabilidades e seu respectivo grau de risco em produtos e serviços existentes
  • Participação na realização de testes de segurança, ajudando a definir escopo e mapeando as ações de melhoria resultantes
  • Participação na análise e resposta a incidentes de segurança, buscando melhoria contínua dos nossos processos e práticas
  • Treinamento, conscientização e colaboração com os times de desenvolvimento para definição de boas práticas de programação e arquitetura de software
  • A pessoa que buscamos atuará dentro dos times de produto, reportando para a área de segurança com o objetivo de garantir o desenvolvimento de novos projetos e a adequação de sistemas existentes às melhores práticas de segurança. Outra atividade importante será na educação dos times nestas práticas e no uso de ferramental disponibilizado pelo time de segurança para a construção e operação de sistemas de forma confiável.

Como é ser Analista de Segurança em Desenvolvimento Senior ?

Dentre as atividades de trabalho esperadas, estão :

  • Buscar conhecer os produtos e serviços do time onde vai atuar, sendo pró-ativo na busca de documentações e informações
  • Discernimento para saber priorizar as ações que serão negociadas com time, organizando-as numa escala de criticidade que dê visibilidade ao que é mais urgente
  • Usar sua experiência e intuição de segurança para procurar ameaças nos ambientes corporativos e de produção
  • Se estiverem faltando dados importantes de que precisamos é esperada a iniciativa de buscá-los ou solicitá-los
  • Desenvolver soluções criativas para problemas de segurança complexos que equilibrem as necessidades e os riscos dos negócios
  • Inglês Avançado / Fluente

O que esperamos de você :

  • Ter capacidade de identificar oportunidades de melhorias, novas soluções e alertas que possam beneficiar e / ou facilitar a operação
  • Monitorar indicadores de segurança e influenciar o time na correção dos problemas, usando processos e meios disponíveis para buscar a priorização deste trabalho
  • Usar habilidades de influência e negociação para direcionar os times a corrigirem problemas ou a utilizarem arquiteturas adequadas do ponto de vista de segurança
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com autonomia
  • Comunicar-se de forma concisa, franca e assertiva, sabendo traduzir problemas complexos para uma linguagem acessível ao público com o qual se comunica
  • Possuir curso Superior em Segurança da Informação, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software ou cursos relacionados
  • Paixão por aprender e prosperar em um ambiente dinâmico e em constante mudança
  • Conhecimento de vetores de ataque comuns
  • Conhecimento dos serviços básicos e conceitos de segurança de Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)
  • Conhecimento dos serviços básicos e conceitos de segurança relacionados a Threat Modeling, SAST, DAST, SCA (Software Composition Analysis) e Secret Scanning
  • Experiência com linha de comando comum do Linux, monitoramento de segurança, análise de logs e ferramentas forenses
  • Facilidade de trabalhar dentro de times multi-disciplinares com metodologia ágil

O que aumentam suas chances :

  • Experiência com gestão de incidentes, vulnerabilidade, riscos, etc
  • Experiência em projetos voltados para a área financeira
  • Conhecimentos de programação
  • Excelentes habilidades na língua inglesa (escrita e verbal)

Nossos Benefícios

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico
  • Hospital Digital, da Vitta: contamos com uma equipe médica multidisciplinar, terapeutas e um time de saúde disponível 24 horas por dia 7 dias por semana de forma rápida e prática
  • Vale Refeição e / ou Vale Alimentação

  • Benefício Educação - Plataforma interna com acesso a diversos livros, podcasts, treinamentos e vídeo aulas visando o autodesenvolvimento (Studa e Biblioteca StoneCo)
